cases.name: A and B allocate same numeric slot/generation
cases.required_behavior: reject foreign-source dereference despite equal numeric token

cases.name: caller owner differs
cases.required_behavior: deny read/write without changing any actor state

cases.name: actor incarnation restarts
cases.required_behavior: deny old-ref read, write and release

cases.name: generation expires on ref release
cases.required_behavior: reject stale token even if same offset/class reused

cases.name: generation reaches 4095
cases.required_behavior: retire slot, never wrap into valid old token

cases.name: null and forged high slot
cases.required_behavior: reject before dereference and before native pointer computation

cases.name: type id mismatch
cases.required_behavior: reject typed access or conversion without mutable state changes

cases.name: payload offset misaligned or out of bounds
cases.required_behavior: reject before memory access with overflow-safe arithmetic

cases.name: critical-read and exclusive write borrow
cases.required_behavior: reject conflicting aliases in typed IR before codegen

cases.name: Ref32 carried as actor message
cases.required_behavior: reject implicit cross-domain transport; no cast to ActorRef

cases.name: borrow spans suspension without pin proof
cases.required_behavior: reject before emitting compiled guest artifact

cases.name: STOP and sibling actor
cases.required_behavior: quiesce/scrub/retire owner without affecting sibling ref validity
